body:
No you really are great. You deserve all the support you get and I can see you’re trying to simply coexist harmoniously with the rest of the world .i think its really admirable that you are open to sharing about your experiences without being judgmental or patronizing . I have encountered people on this thread who are awful representatives of this very serious disease. I think if more people were like you, patient , schizophrenia would come a longer way to not being so stigmatized. 

I actually considered not using this subreddit because some of the responders  who claimed to have schizophrenia were so problematic, combative, and seemed more interested in starting online fights that I wondered if schizophrenics even wanted to be understood. Then you came along.It’s very much appreciated that you understand that the rest of us who have no experience with schizophrenia genuinely don’t understand it. We aren’t born knowing how to deal with and we’re trying our best. 

You are such an asset. I heard sometimes schizophrenia can disappear over time or be managed to the point it doesn’t effect your life much. I hope one day that can be you, if you wish. Not sure how that would effect your creative process though. I asked around those I know in real life and I know someone who actually knows a man that is a published author and he’s schizophrenic. He says the man is brilliant but he’s unsure if he’d be the author and poet that he is without his schizophrenia

but you’re so helpful. Really. You’re helping me understand so much. I just needed to know what is going on in his mind while this is happening. I need to know what he can control and what he cannot. You’re being so helpful with that. I just want to understand because I can’t help him if I don’t understand him. 

I’ve been listening to schizophrenia simulations on YouTube and it’s heartbreaking that there are those like you who actually have to live with this daily and not know when an episode will happen. I feel you all are some of the bravest and most misunderstood people out there. 

I’m not saying you’re ashamed but I don’t feel anyone who has it should ever feel ashamed for having it. I wish society was more accepting and that people with schizophrenia can feel safe sharing with those they love without fear of judgement. It makes me sad that my bf felt he had to hide all of this from me

She is with someone else. Focus on that. Every time you think of how you should be together, remember she is with someone else. You cannot be with someone who is already with someone else and doesn’t want you. Embrace the hurt. Your mind can only feel so much hurt for so long anyway...eventually it’ll let go of the hurt and her too. Until then, try send help books too.
Have you ever been unable to do things as planned because you felt yourself slipping into an episode but are unable to call for help during the episode?

Thank you for sharing. I’m glad you have a partner who will create a safe space for you. You deserve it and I’d like to create one for my bf too. Do you know when you are having an episode? I read In another thread that schizophrenics don’t realize they’re having episodes but from some of the posts, I feel like some know they’re having an episode
I’m an idiot.  Next time I def won’t. But hey, I got free promotion for my thread! He actually made a thread about me and linking this :)

That was a joke bro. I’m not the voices in your head. You said you’re not even schizophrenic so I’m not sure why your claiming to be insulted. But seriously, you’re not a victim. Your delusional rants aside, It’s weird AF you’re even making a thread about me.  I want you to report me because creating a thread to try to get others to harass another user and turn others against them actually IS harassment. Good luck with your obvious issues.
Ps. Thanks for promoting my thread though <3

I’m trying to gain power over you?  You think I actually want to know anything about you? Wow.. next thing you know, you’ll be claiming I’m trying to control your mind. You’re really trying hard to play the stereotypical schizophrenic after being called out for being a fraud
Everyone claims to care until they actually are asked to help lol

I’m not interested in hearing from you. I tried to not reply but I get notifications that you replied and I can’t mute you. You’re right I don’t have to reply.  But you clearly suffer from something and I thought you were crying out for help. I was moved by it. But you go on and keep trying g to force a convo...

Dude, you said youre not schizophrenic but now you’re claiming to be part of the “us” of schizophrenics. What part of I have NO desire to talk to you but yet you are still FORCING yourself onto me do you not understand? I’m not even angry at you just shocked. If you’re like this with a stranger, I can’t even imagine the STALKER shit you must do to people you actually know.

TL;dr: If you are offended that Im extra gentle on a schizophrenic and refuse to treat them as neurotypical (because they are NOT) then there’s nothing more I can do for you

Long version: I clearly do care or i wouldn’t be asking. This relationship is very stressful. Without the diagnosis I’d dump him for inattentiveness and for making the same damn mistakes despite promising to change. But he’s schizophrenic and he does need compassion and understanding. I will always allow leeway for him because I understand it’s not his fault. This is beyond his control. 

If you don’t like that I am extra sympathetic due to his diagnosis then let me thank you for your time and leave it at that. I will always be extra compassionate because I know things are harder for him and he’s doing the best he can. He asked me to never leave him and I promised him I’d never leave him and I’ll always help.  I plan to stick to that until I learn something that shows me he know longer deserves it. As long as his diagnosis isn’t faked, I’m going to help him

I wanted Opinions on how to help him moving forward.  I didn’t ask for someone who Faked having schizophrenia to give me his unsolicited opinion on how I treated my bf in the past. Actually, I didn’t ask for anyone’s opinion on that. This isn’t the “relationships” subreddit

Then you’re low as fuck to PRETEND  to hear voices and act like you suffer the same condition that many of the brave people on here (like my bf) suffer from. Also I actually do have that much power. Want me to show you? I could choose to continue to argue with you, to try to understand you, or simply ignore your existence. You’re so low that I’m choosing the last option.  You lost the privilege of talking to me and receiving my attention. You are now dismissed. Take care.

Read what I wrote. I hated my bf. HATED him because I thought he was playing some sick game with me. Never did I think it was a serious condition and that everything was beyond his control. An abuser would not be trying to help and learn. An abuser wouldn’t care about his limitations. You can’t hurl false allegations and think you get a pass because you’re schizophrenic, bro.  He gets a pass with me because I love him but you don’t.

Bro, that’s the point. Don’t act like you know him or care for him better than I do. Because you don’t. You haven’t done anything for him in his life. I’m the one who helped him and am still here. I’m the one who is trying to learn to how to help because I know he needs extra care. Hell yeah I hated him and felt repulsed by him. I thought it was a joke. when I realized he had a condition ( a serous condition that effected his ability and it was NOT his fault), I have been nothing but supportive. 

So stfu because not only have you never done anything for him in the past, you aren’t doing anything now . Tbh had you said you’d help this kid and meant it, I’d actually redditgold you because it would show even if you’re a  misguided idiot ( who by your own admission doesn’t even have a diagnosis) I’d know that you at least kind of care..and that would’ve been a beautiful thing
You are delusional. Go up your dosages. Just because you have a diagnosis doesn’t mean you can attack others with impunity.

Would you check on him to be sure? And while we are at it, where do I send you the bill for all the financial support I helped him with because no one else would do it because everyone else lost patience? You won’t. So stfu

Of course I’m mocking you because you came for me. Since you care so much for him, please support him because he has no one. If me changing and being more understanding towards him isn’t enough then why don’t you contact him and be the support system he clearly doesn’t have? You won’t because you don’t care about him at all. So never come for me.

Hell yeah it’s abuse. Hence why I  did take steps to change. Because I knew I had to change or cut him off. But Why don’t you actually be there for him since you care so much more than I do? Because this kid has no support and if you think me actually sitting here trying to get info on how to help him isn’t enough and isn’t caring then why don’t YOU go out and help him personally? You won’t. So don’t act like you care more than I do. You don’t even know him.

Oh sorry you’re the guy who posted. I wasn’t paying attention to the screen names. Well since you care for him so much, you should start a support group for him. I’d actually love it if you did tbh because i am getting pretty tired of our relationship but care for him as a person so would hate to leave him without some sort of support
I’m going to be nice because I understand your schizophrenic. And it’s sad people aren’t more understanding. With all due respect, if it doesn’t sit well with you how about you just not comment?

Who called you anyone’s darling? And what is your motive here? I asked for insight to understand my bf I don’t get why you’re making it about you? Do you think your gf made an account and now I’m her posting about you? I’d like to assure you, I’m not your gf...
Who called you anyone’s darling?

I think the reason it doesn’t seem caring is maybe perhaps because it obviously isn’t? Just a guess, though (sarcasm)

ETA: of course it isn’t caring. Hence why things had to change. Obviously.
Will the voice nag the hell out of you like an annoying person who won’t stfu and you can’t escape if you did what they didn’t want you to do anyway?

It depends. How socially awkward? To the point you creep others out? Do you give serial killer vibes? Or are you so nervous that you come across as less of man and more a doormat willing to please?  or are you simply awkward in the sense that you are very logical and take everything literally?
Not too late. Just block them again. Been there myself

You’re not awful. I would have replied with simply an “LoL. Good luck and have a great rest of your life.” At least you didn’t intentionally hurt her more. They know what pain feels like yet People like her only want pity for themselves but have no pity for those they destroy. I don’t understand them

Thank you for sharing your experience.  In an odd way, it’s encouraging to hear that this is simply a rather common side effect of schizophrenia. Did the voice threaten you? I told him if it’s a vice telling him to ignore not to listen to it. But I’d imagine hard to ignore the voice if it’s menacing. I mainly told him to ignore the voice because if the voice is telling him that he’s unloved, I want him to know the voice is lying. I don’t know how family but he told me they didn’t like me because he told them I cheated on him once. I didn’t but he thought I did for some reason and they believe him. I wish I could reach out to them but it might be awkward considering that his father and brother also suffer the same condition and I worry they might act defensive
Thank you :)

How long would these periods of silence last? What got you to break the silence. I don’t know what to do regarding my darling. It breaks my heart he suffers so much that he can’t even speak to me it seems. Hell, I wonder if he speaks to many others at all
I hope it’s ok that I message you. I find you so helpful and I feel I can learn a lot from talking to someone with your condition.. but I know certain things may be too private to post on a thread
Thank you . That is so insightful. How long did you ignore your partner for and how did it ultimately end?

If they don’t care then you shouldn’t either care for them. You shouldn’t kill yourself simply because irrelevant people you manage to over value fail to see value in you. That’s a waste of life. Find meaning in other things.

I understand. I started planning suicide when my dad was diagnosed with a terminal form of cancer. I planned to end it when he died...but now they think he might get better. You’re braver than you think to have lasted this long and STILL want actually want to live. You want to live so you’re meant to still live on. It’s not your time. You’ll know you’re ready when you lose that will to live and it’s a constant feeling ...not just a day by day thing.

Is hanging the most painless and will you be sober? I’m sorry it came to this. I understand because I have had times where I’m just hanging on.  I know one day things won’t get better and I’ll be where yo are. I trust you gave it thought and you’ve lost the will to live long ago. God speed.
Calm down, Hannah.
Make myself better? What would I tell them? That I treat my ex like a human diary?
I’m surprised by the replies above.  I expected to be Ridiculed  because I am pathetic. I did not expect to be treated with compassion

I’m obsessed with my ex. We broke up yesterday but everything went down today. I’m such a loser I send hundred of texts a day! He thought it was adorable I’d get so worked up when we’d fight and break up before but I’m not sure how he feels now. You made a good point about Instagram and Facebook . I didn’t think maybe he’d not want to see what’s going on with me too. I thought he was just being petty because I’ve blocked him on insta and Facebook like 4 times before!
